title: Ofie Kronkron no mu Ɔkra a Ɔte Abotare
intro: Wɔ Kur’aan nkratafa mu no, onipa bi fi odiyifo kɛse bi abusua mu ba, a wɔde mae sɛ akyɛde wɔ onyin mu. Wɔhyɛ ɔkra yi ho afahyɛ wɔ nokware a enhinhim ne dwuma a emu dɔ a odii wɔ kronkronbea a anka ɛbɛyɛ gyidi kanea a wɔde besi hɔ no mu. Bere a worekenkan nsɛnkyerɛnne no, tie ɛnne a efi tete no mu yiye, efisɛ ɛkasa wɔ onipa a odi kan no mu.
clues: Wɔaka me ho asɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu ka odiyifoɔ foforɔ ho sɛ akyɛdeɛ a wɔde ama ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ne mfeɛ akɔ anim.
Na meyɛ mma baanu a wɔde maa saa odiyifo no wɔ ne mfe a edi akyiri mu no mu biako.
Wɔkamfo me wɔ Kur’aan mu sɛ meyɛ nokware ma m’asɛm.
Mesoaa nkɔmhyɛni anuonyam na wɔsomaa me sɛ ɔbɔfo.
Mekaa me papa ho ma wɔmaa Fie Kronkron no fapem so.
Wɔkae me sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ abotare no mu biako, na ofie kronkron a yesii no bɛyɛɛ baabi a nkurɔfo san kɔ na wonya ahobammɔ.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Kaaba fapem a wɔde bɛma so ne Ibrahim
Israelfo a wodii wɔn anim fii Misraim
trial.answer: Kaaba fapem a wɔde bɛma so ne Ibrahim

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔkan no ka ɔyarefo no ho
Wɔkan no ka nkonyaayifo no ho
Wokan no ka atiafoa no ho
Wɔkan no ka nyaatwomfo no ho
outcome.answer: Wɔkan no ka ɔyarefo no ho

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
